study_pi: Khaled, Walid T; Scheel, Christina H
comments: Reassembled from CxG deposit for iHBCA v1.0; pass-through ontology fields. Paper states hg19 reference but ArrayExpress submission (P-MTAB-103889) specifies Ensembl 94 (GRCh38); GRCh38 reported here as authoritative. Batch 3 used v2 chemistry and Cell Ranger 2.1.1; Batches 1-2 used v3 and Cell Ranger 3.0.2. emptyDrops used for empty droplet removal (cell calling) not ambient RNA correction.
description: Single-cell RNA sequencing of 110,744 cells from human milk and non-lactating breast tissue across 16 donors characterizing transcriptional changes during lactation.
